text:
emily: FYI: new release cadence and freeze policy goes live Mon 2026-03-30. Major feature trains -> biweekly; minor/patch -> weekly. Goal: more predictable canaries and fewer urgent rollbacks.

chen: Quick Q  will this lengthen canaries? Our latency experiments assume short windows.

emily: Yes. Defaults: major = 120m, minor/patch = 45m, emergency hotpatch lane stays 30m. We can make contract exceptions for Dedicated tenants.

rahul: Auto-revert behavior? Need concrete thresholds for oncall runbooks.

emily: Auto-fallback: if error rate >= 75% for a continuous 5m, traffic flips to previous variant automatically. That is a fallback event. Full rollback requires deploy-owner confirmation unless auto-rollback is set.

deploy-bot: config-update: canary_defaults set -> {major:120m, minor:45m, hotpatch:30m} effective 2026-03-30T09:00:00Z

samir: I'll update the runbook and release checklist. I'll add a copy/paste canary JSON snippet and an exemptions link.

maya: +1 to adding a short customer blurb for Dedicated customers (samir, happy to co-edit).

emily: Thanks all. I'll post the internal announcement tomorrow and schedule a 30m AMA. If you see anything missing, reply here.
